correctness.rationale: The unit group consists exactly of singleton subsets, so automorphisms restrict to ±1 and unit-fixing maps commute with translations. Translation orbit sizes 4,4,2,4,1; A orbit squares lie in C whereas C squares absorb, B unique idempotent fixes shift; A+A enforces C shift 2k. All four K_k preserve 225 products and ± inversion gives order-eight semidirect with inversion conjugacy. Reduced-submonoid stabilizer is exactly ± group automorphisms. Independent finite product matrix and 32 normalized candidates checked; not inferred from 15! search.
residual_risks: Finite computations corroborate rather than prove unbounded claims.
